fields.proposed_value: Discovery call with Pampa Agro. Field reps visit about two hundred dealers weekly, but visits, orders and promises are recorded on paper and in spreadsheets, so they get lost. 38 users need one app that works offline, with GPS check-in, and sends dealer orders to Orion ERP. A field demo with two reps is set for 11 Nov.
